create_argparse_main_decorator: create a Dora experiment main function using the argparse_main decorator with a custom argparse parser
build_ArgparseMain_class: build an ArgparseMain instance wrapping a main function with an argparse parser and DoraConfig for experiment management
run_DecoratedMain_call: run a DecoratedMain instance to execute an experiment with argument parsing and XP initialization
review_init_xp_method: review the DecoratedMain init_xp method that initializes XP folders and caches argv to JSON files
test_value_to_argv: test the ArgparseMain value_to_argv method to convert Python dicts, lists, and strings into command-line argv entries
